claim: Aponiente's 2026 tasting menu is priced at 400 euros per person, with optional drink pairings: NoLo 180 euros, Albariza 210 euros, Diatoms 330 euros (VAT included).
quote: MENU APONIENTE 2026 400 E individual (official menu PDF; pairings NoLo 180, Albariza 210, Diatoms 330, IVA incluido)

claim: Aponiente takes reservations via its website booking system, phone 956 851 870 / 606 225 859, or email reservas@aponiente.com, and located at C/ Francisco Cossi Ochoa s/n.
quote: 956 851 870 – 606 225 859 ... reservas@aponiente.com ... C/ Francisco Cossi Ochoa, s/n El Puerto de Santa María, Cádiz

claim: For the 2026 season Aponiente serves part of the meal outdoors in the marshes around the tide mill via walkways over the water, with a kitchen set in the estero landscape; the season had opened by early May 2026.
quote: Part of the meal is now served outdoors in the marshes around the tide mill, with walkways over the water, a kitchen in the estero landscape ... radically innovative, but also deeply local

claim: Aponiente, run by Ángel León 'Chef of the Sea', occupies a converted 19th-century tide mill and is celebrated for sea-based cuisine respecting the ecosystem.
quote: Ángel León, known as 'The Chef of the Sea', has transformed this old tide mill into the epicentre of an exceptional gastronomic experience

claim: Reservations at Aponiente should be made well in advance as tables are limited, with seatings for lunch (roughly 13:00-14:15) and dinner (roughly 20:00-21:15).
quote: tables are limited during specific time slots for lunch (1–2:15) and dinner (8–9:15)

claim: La Taberna del Chef del Mar, Ángel León's casual venue in central El Puerto on the site where Aponiente earned its first two stars, serves shareable tapas/raciones (rice with plankton, squid croquettes and tartare, flame-grilled tuna, octopus skewers).
quote: located in the very heart of El Puerto de Santa María at the same place where Ángel León and his crew achieved 2 Michelin stars for Aponiente ... rice with plankton, squid croquettes and squid tartare ... flame-grilled tuna steak and octopus skewers

claim: La Taberna del Chef del Mar dishes run roughly 5-25 euros a la carte with fixed menus around 45 and 55 euros, in a casual friendly atmosphere.
quote: average prices ranging from 5€ to 25€ ... fixed menus at 45 and 55 euros ... casual and friendly spot

claim: Romerijo is a 70-plus-year El Puerto institution (since 1952) on the Ribera del Marisco where customers buy cooked and fried seafood by weight from 30+ specialties and eat on the terrace.
quote: más de 60 años de historia ... dedicada a la compra, manipulación, elaboración y venta de marisco y pescado ... compran al peso de más de 30 especialidades

claim: Mantúa (Israel Ramos) and LU Cocina y Alma (JuanLu Fernández) are one-Michelin-star restaurants located in neighbouring Jerez de la Frontera, not in El Puerto itself.
quote: Mantúa is a One Star Michelin restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide España ... The restaurant is located in Jerez de la Frontera, not El Puerto de Santa María
